Name: Omnitron Griese GmbH
Description:
Festnetz und Mobilfunk Provider stehen unter Druck, da Industrie und Regierung darauf drängen Breitband flächendeckend auszubauen. Die bevorzugte Technologie um dieses Ziel zu erreichen ist Glasfaser. Hiermit sind zukunftssicher hohe Bandbreiten garantiert. Der Nachteil sind die nötigen Tiefbauarbeiten. Diese verursachen hohe Kosten, sind langwierig und können durch Sperrungen den Straßenverkehr beeinträchtigen. Überlandleitungen sind keine wirkliche Alternative, auch wenn kurze Masten schnell installiert sind. Die Ästhetik leidet und durch Wind und Wetter können ganze Dörfer für Tage vom Netz getrennt sein.



Die hohen Kosten werden auf den Endkunden umgelegt, welcher neben der Nutzung aktiver Hardware auch deren Wartung, Instandhaltung und den Ausbau neuer Netze finanzieren muss. Provider handeln und denken dabei wirtschaftlich.

Eine Alternative zum Glasfaserkabel, derer sich große Provider gerne bedienen, ist der Richtfunk. Eine Punkt- zu- Punkt Verbindung durch die Luft mit bis zu 40GB/s und einer extrem hohen Verfügbarkeit, selbst bei sehr schlechtem Wetter. Ein Richtfunksystem benötigt keine Baugenehmigung, sondern je nach gewähltem System, eine Frequenzzuteilung, welche innerhalb weniger Wochen zugeteilt wird. Der Aufbau des Systems dauert nur wenige Stunden und ist auch ohne die optional verfügbare Verschlüsselung sehr abhörsicher. Name: H2020-Caladan
Description:
The CALADAN project brings together a supply chain that will enable automatic wafer-scale assembly of Terabit/s capable optical engines through the use of the micro transfer printing technology. 

Both SiGe BiCMOS driver and receiver chiplets (fabricated using a modified version of an established SiGe process), as well as GaAs quantum dot laser coupons will be transfer printed on 300mm Silicon Photonic wafers. The purpose is the parallel assembly of optical transceiver engines, thus significantly reducing production costs compared to conventional sequential flip-chip assembly processes. In addition fast vision-based automatic fiber attachment equipment and processes are being developed, again with the view to lower the cost associated with manufacturing of ultra high-speed optical transceivers.

The European project Caladan is an initiative of the Photonics Public Private Partnership (PPP), and has received funding from the European Union’s Horizon 2020 innovation programme under grant agreement No 825453.

Name: ALLEGRO EU
Description:
ALLEGRO aims at designing and validating a novel end-to-end sliceable, reliable, and secure architecture for next-generation optical networks, achieving high transmission/switching capacity -- with 10 Tb/s for optoelectronic devices and 1 Pbt/s for optical fiber systems --; low power consumption/cost -- with > 25% savings -- and secure infrastructures and data transfers.
The architecture relies on key enabling innovations: i) smart, coherent transceivers exploiting multi-band & multi-fiber technologies for P2P and P2MP applications, based on e.g., high-speed plasmonic modulators/photodetectors and programmable silicon photonic integrated waveguide meshes; ii) loss-less, energy-efficient transparent photonic integrated optical switches, eliminating OEO conversions, e.g., with on-chip amplification in the O-band for datacom applications; iii) a consistent approach to security, in terms of functional/protocol architectures and communications, further improving QKD systems, enabling optical channel co-existence and researching on quantum-resistant (postquantum) cryptography, developing systems based on physically unclonable functions; and iv) a scalable AI/ML assisted control and orchestration system, responsible for autonomous networking, dynamic and constrained service provisioning, function placement and resource allocation, leveraging devices increasing programmability and overall network softwarization. 
To achieve the target objectives and KPIs, ALLEGRO has defined a clear methodology ending in ambitious demonstrators. The consortium includes a good balance of industry and research/academia with know-how in complementary fields. The results of ALLEGRO will be disseminated in leading conferences, events, and high-impact journals. They will have a concrete and measurable economic and social impact, contributing towards achieving key European objectives, reinforcing European leadership and digital sovereignty in the ongoing digital and green transition.

Lot Internet GmbH was founded in 2011 by business analysts, marketing & sales experts, crawling specialists and IT professionals with many years of professional experience. Our B2B customers are well-known online marketplaces in the real estate, automotive, jobs, e-commerce and telecommunications sectors, which use our data for market research, competition monitoring and customer analysis as a basis for decision-making.

We provide you with the data basis and transparency for customer-oriented marketing and successful sales through:

- a deep and comprehensive insight into your market
- detailed and up-to-date information about your customers
- up-to-date information about your competitors
- comprehensive price analysis
- Provision of potential customers / leads

We generate tailor-made marketing and sales solutions specifically for your individual requirements. We crawl and extract the desired data from the Internet using efficient web spiders. We clean up this data basis and link it to other data sources if necessary. In the next step, we develop comprehensive dashboards, reports and analyzes or deliver the data directly to your data warehouse.

Your sales, marketing, management or product management receives the crucial information about your competition, potential customers, market prices and existing customers on this database created by crawling in order to generate additional growth.

Description:
Unser 2009 gegründetes Unternehmen mit Hauptsitz bei München ist Ideenschmiede und einer der führenden Hersteller von speziellen technischen Lösungen für den passiven Glasfasernetzausbauer.

Mit Erfahrung und Know-how entwickeln und produzieren wir hochwertige Lösungen „made in Germany“. Unsere Produkte sind praxis- und lösungsorientiert, konsequent durchdacht und anwenderfreundlich. Sie minimieren den Zeitaufwand, die Kosten und die Fehleranfälligkeit während und nach der Verlegung und schützen so langfristig die technische Sicherheit Ihres Netzes und damit aktiv den Werterhalt Ihrer Investition.

Unser Unternehmen ist spezialisiert auf die Entwicklung, Herstellung und den Vertrieb von Produkten, die im Bereich des passiven Glasfaserausbaus Anwendung finden. Um innovative Lösungen zu gewährleisten, verfügen wir über drei separate Entwicklungsabteilungen, die jeweils für die spezifischen Fertigungsbereiche zuständig sind. Alle Produkte, die wir vertreiben, werden vollständig in unserem Hause entwickelt und gefertigt.

Auf unsere Expertise vertrauen zahlreiche führende Planer, Kommunen, Stadtwerke, Zweckverbände, Tiefbaufirmen und Telekommunikationsunternehmen in ganz Deutschland.

Description:
MOXZ is a patented wireless transceiver technology on the physical layer. The transceiver uses hereby a novel waveform for the transmission, which allows for a fully integrated communication and sensing (ISAC).

MOXZ enables therefore radar-applications with integrated communications capabilities, required for autonomous driving, industrial automation as well as the future generations of wireless networks. Furthermore, MOXZ also provides communications in challenging environments where classical approaches are only working very inefficient or even not at all.

The technology was developed in collaboration with the Technische Universität Berlin, the California Institute of Technology, and the California University of Irvine.

Name: Doro DACH
Description:
„Den Senioren gehört die Zukunft! Während der Anteil der über 65-Jährigen zunimmt, wird die Zielgruppe immer aktiver. Gleichzeitig verfügt sie über die Ressourcen, um aus dieser Lebenslust zu schöpfen. Was gibt es Schöneres, als sie dabei zu unterstützen? Das 1974 gegründete schwedische Unternehmen zählt zu den führenden europäischen Telekommunikationsanbietern, die den Alltag von Senioren erleichtern und bereichern. Die vielfältigen Geräte und Dienstleistungen sind das Ergebnis aus 45 Jahren Erfahrung.

Damit sorgt Doro auch für mehr Zuversicht bei Verwandten und Freunden, die ihre Liebsten in Sicherheit wissen.
 
Das an der Nasdaq Stockholm notiert Unternehmen erwirtschaftete 2020 einen Nettoumsatz von 116,5 Mio. Euro. Im Headquarter in Malmö und den Vertriebsniederlassungen in 27 Ländern vertreiben insgesamt 87 Mitarbeiter, die vielfältigen Lösungen von Doro.
 
Geschäftsführer Michael Rabenstein leitet von Wien aus das lokale Geschäft im DACH-Raum, unterstützt von einem starken lokalen Team aus Mitarbeitern, Agenturen und Vertriebspartnern. Im Fokus steht die Entwicklung und Umsetzung einer neuen Doro-Welt, die weit über die reine Hardware hinausgeht und die gesamte Lebenswelt der Senioren und ihrer Liebsten umfasst. #WirSindDoro

Name: BCIX
Description:
BCIX (Berlin Commercial Internet Exchange e.V.) is a neutral not-for-profit association and Berlin’s leading Internet Exchange Point (IXP) founded in 2002.

BCIX (BCIX Management GmbH) operates a distributed network for connecting customers like Carriers, ISPs, CDNs, Web Startups etc. to exchange their IPv4 and IPv6 Internet traffic.

The BCIX network is based on a DWDM optical network backbone and Ethernet platform nodes for connecting BCIX customers with Ethernet port speeds from 1Gbps to 100Gbps.

The BCIX network nodes are distributed over nine different and highly secure data centers in Berlin:

 * 3U Telecom, Lorenzweg 5, 12099 Berlin
 * CarrierColo (I/P/B/), Kitzingstraße 15, 12277 Berlin
 * CarrierColo (I/P/B/), Lützowstraße 105/106, 10785 Berlin

DOKOM21 ist Mitgründer des im September 2020 initiierten Internetknotens Ruhr-CIX, der unter anderem in den Rechenzentren der DOKOM21 beheimatet ist.

Ob Server-, Rack- oder Flächenmiete - Für jeden Bedarf die richtige Lösung!

DOKOM21 betreibt Rechenzentren mit einer Fläche von über 4.600 Quadratmetern an drei räumlich getrennten Standorten im gesamten Ruhrgebiet. Die Rechenzentren von DOKOM21 sind nach dem Prinzip der Geo-Redundanz aufgebaut. Dadurch können sie nicht gleichzeitig von dem gleichen Schadensereignis betroffen sein. Durch eine moderne Gebäude-Infrastruktur mit hochverfügbaren Glasfaseranbindungen werden Ihre sensiblen Unternehmensdaten hier sicher und umfassend geschützt. Dazu trägt auch die N+1-Redundanz bei allen wesentlichen Komponenten bei, die einen gesicherten Betrieb garantiert.

Die Rechenzentren von DOKOM21 besitzen eine direkte Anbindung an den Ruhr-CIX und DE-CIX und den damit verbundenen Zugang zu Microsoft 365 und anderen Cloud-Diensten.

Wir stellen Ihnen individuell auf Ihre Anforderungen abgestimmte Rechenzentrumslösungen zur Verfügung.

Description:

Als Tochterunternehmen der TEAG, der Thüringer Energie AG, verfügen wir über ein thüringenweites Glasfasernetz mit einer Länge von rund 7.000 Kilometern und mit mehr als 200.000 Faserkilometern.

Damit betreiben wir das zweitgrößte Festnetz in Thüringen. Der Grund für unsere besondere Leistungsstärke: Die Thüringer Netkom bringt Glasfaserkabel bis zum Kabelverzweiger – teilweise bis an die Haustür. Unsere technische Infrastruktur eröffnet Ihnen die Welt der hohen Bandbreiten und schnellen DSL-Verbindungen.

Name: R-KOM GmbH
Description:

Als kommunales Unternehmen richtet sich unser Handeln nach dem für die Region entstehenden Mehrwert. Mit den Städten, in denen wir unsere Netze errichten pflegen wir eine dauerhaft, offene und faire Partnerschaft.

Seit 2009 bietet R-KOM auch Dienste für Privatkunden an. Unter der Initiative Glasfaser Ostbayern schließen wir Gebäude direkt an unser Glasfasernetz an und bauen so eines der modernsten Kommunikationsnetze Europas. Durch Open Access ermöglicht es R-KOM anderen Telekommunikationsunternehmen von den getätigten Investitionen zu profitierten. Diese können ihre Kunden schnell und einfach über Glasfaser Ostbayern anschalten und auf eigene Ausbauten verzichten.

In der G-FIT Gesellschaft für innovative Telekommunikationsprodukte mbH & Co. KG arbeiten wir mit anderen regionalen Telekommunikationsgesellschaften im süddeutschen Raum zusammen und erzielen so Skaleneffekte, die nachhaltig unsere Wirtschaftlichkeit sichern.

Über 130 Mitarbeiter arbeiten täglich daran R-KOM weiterzuentwickeln.

Die Zufriedenheit der Kunden ist das wichtigste Gut für ein Unternehmen. Daher kommt dem Customer Service eine sehr große Bedeutung zu. Wir von colpari nehmen Dir diese anspruchsvolle Aufgabe von den Schultern.

René hat unter anderem Kommunikationsprozesse, Coaching-Techniken und Konfliktmanagement studiert und wiederum in einem Call Center Agenten trainiert. Zudem ist er Qualitätsbeauftragter und Fachkraft für Datenschutz. 

colpari setzt auf „Insourcing“. Das bedeutet: Für Deinen Customer Service bekommst Du von uns eine virtuelle Umgebung zur Verfügung gestellt. Sie ist passgenau auf die Bedürfnisse Deines Unternehmens zugeschnitten.

Im Gegensatz zu einem Call-Center zahlst Du nur den tatsächlichen Zeitaufwand der Agenten. Dazu kommt, dass unsere Verträge keine Mindestlaufzeit haben. Wir rühmen uns damit, dass uns bislang noch kein Kunde verlassen hat, weil er unzufrieden war. Unser Ziel ist es, das so zu lassen!

Im Vergleich zu einem herkömmlichen Call-Center bietet colpari Deinem Unternehmen einen unschätzbaren Mehrwert. Dank unserer Lösungen gestaltest Du Deinen Customer Support komplett maßgeschneidert und hast die volle Kontrolle. Sei es die Implementierung in Dein bestehendes System, die Flexibilität der Kanäle oder die Gestaltung unserer Preise – bei uns weißt Du immer, was Dich erwartet. Und das kommt nicht nur Dir zugute, sondern vor allem auch Deinen Kunden.

Aufbauend auf dieser Erfahrung bietet das Unternehmen inzwischen ausgeklügelte Überwachungslösungen auch für Energiekabel- und Fernwärme-Rohrnetze an. Seit Sommer 2012 ist LANCIER Monitoring offizieller deutscher Repräsentant für JUN-AIR Kompressoren und zertifiziertes Service-Center. Anwender sind nationale und internationale Netzbetreiber, Energieversorger und die Großindustrie. Auf Basis eines über 50-jährigen Erfahrungsschatzes arbeiten unsere Ingenieure kontinuierlich an der Entwicklung neuer Ideen für effektive und bedienerfreundliche Überwachungssysteme und -geräte. Der enge Kontakt zu Anwendern und Hochschulen hilft ihnen dabei aktuelle Probleme mit neuestem Know-how zu lösen. Ein Labor mit modernster Technik unterstützt sie optimal. Der Name LANCIER Monitoring steht weltweit für innovative Lösungen, Zuverlässigkeit und Qualität.

Description: Mobilshop GmbH is a German wholesale company that sells mobile phones and  other portable electronic devices.

Name: Vodafone
Description:
At Vodafone, our purpose is to connect everyone. From the seabed to the stars, we provide innovative mobile and fixed connectivity solutions to empower our customers across the globe. And we're constantly expanding coverage to bridge continents and spread inclusion, even in the most remote places.
 
When everyone is connected, we can create a future full of possibilities.
 
Find more information at www.vodafone.com

#EveryoneConnected

Name: Ericsson
Description:
The future of mobile isn’t on the horizon, it’s happening now. At Ericsson, we’re building the foundation for an open network ecosystem where industries, developers, and enterprises thrive.

The convergence of 5G, AI, cloud, and network APIs isn’t just a technological shift; it’s a transformation that is redefining industries and enhancing everyday life. Open, programmable networks are enabling real-time innovation and unlocking new business models across the globe.

Imagine a world where developers can dynamically access network capabilities on demand, where enterprises don’t just use connectivity but shape it. This isn’t a distant vision, it’s the ecosystem we’re creating today.

Collaboration fuels everything we do. By working across industries, we’re designing a future where connectivity isn’t just seamless. It’s intelligent, programmable, and transformative.

The shift is happening. Are you part of it?

Name: Deutsche Telekom
Description:
Welcome to Deutsche Telekom. As one of the world's most valuable brands, we design innovative solutions and products in the areas of connectivity, networks, digitalization and security. #connectingyourworld
 
At Deutsche Telekom, we believe that each and every one of us has the power to move society forward. That's why we're committed to creating a culture of collaboration and innovation that everyone can participate in. We believe that diversity and inclusion are the key to creative solutions.

These include flexible working hours, hybrid and remote work, learning and development opportunities, health and wellbeing, as well as attractive employee benefits.

Name: Rakuten Symphony
Description:
Rakuten Symphony is reimagining telecom, changing supply chain norms and disrupting outmoded thinking that threatens the industry’s pursuit of rapid innovation and growth. Based on proven modern infrastructure practices, its open interface platforms make it possible to launch and operate advanced mobile services in a fraction of the time and cost of conventional approaches, with no compromise to network quality or security. Rakuten Symphony has operations in Japan, the United States, Singapore, India, South Korea, Europe, and the Middle East Africa region. For more information, visit: https://symphony.rakuten.com

Building on the technology Rakuten used to launch Japan’s newest mobile network, we are taking our mobile offering global.

To support our ambitions to provide an innovative cloud-native telco platform for our customers, Rakuten Symphony is looking to recruit and develop top talent from around the globe. We are looking for individuals to join our team across all functional areas of our business – from sales to engineering, support functions to product development.

Let’s build the future of mobile telecommunications together!

About Rakuten
Rakuten Group, Inc. (TSE: 4755) is a global technology leader in services that empower individuals, communities, businesses and society. Founded in Tokyo in 1997 as an online marketplace, Rakuten has expanded to offer services in e-commerce, fintech, digital content and communications to 2 billion members around the world. The Rakuten Group has more than 30,000 employees, and operations in 30 countries and regions. For more information visit https://global.rakuten.com/corp/.

Name: Vodafone Business
Description:
Vodafone Business is part of the Vodafone Group. We help businesses of every size to embrace positive change through digital communications technologies - today, tomorrow and into the future.

We work with the world's largest multinational companies, fast growing enterprises, Government teams, ambitious start-ups and small businesses around the world.

We can provide services globally, regionally and locally – mobile, fixed, unified communications, Internet of Things (IoT) and cloud and security - connecting the people, places and things that matter to businesses – wherever they are.

#TogetherWeCan

Name: Colt Technology Services
Description:
Colt Technology Services (Colt) is a global digital infrastructure company which creates extraordinary connections to help businesses succeed. Powered by amazing people and like-minded partners, Colt is driven by its purpose: to put the power of the digital universe in the hands of its customers, wherever, whenever and however they choose.

Since 1992, Colt has set itself apart through its deep commitment to its customers, growing from its heritage in the City of London to a global business spanning 40+ countries, with over 6,000 employees and more than 80 offices around the world. For more information, please visit www.colt.net

Name: American Tower
Description:
At American Tower, our vision of Building a More Connected World reflects our purpose: enabling seamless, secure, and sustainable connectivity that empowers people, businesses, and communities. As a global leader in digital infrastructure, we provide the foundation for mobile and broadband networks to expand, innovate, and bridge digital divides. Our commitment to this vision extends beyond technology—it is about creating opportunities, fostering economic growth, and enhancing quality of life through reliable and responsible connectivity.
With the increasing popularity of mobile data services and emerging technologies like 5G, edge and cloud computing, our collaborative teams tailor, expand and innovate solutions to meet current and future connectivity needs.

Name: Rohde & Schwarz
Description:
Rohde & Schwarz is a global technology group striving for a safer and connected world. With its Test & Measurement, Technology Systems and Networks & Cybersecurity Divisions, the company creates tomorrow's innovations today. The company's leading-edge products and solutions empower industrial, regulatory and military customers to attain technological and digital sovereignty.

Innovation has been part of Rohde & Schwarz since the very beginning. The company founders Dr. Lothar Rohde and Dr. Hermann Schwarz were technological pioneers. With their hands-on entrepreneurial spirit, the two college friends entered the unexplored field of RF engineering. Ninety years later, the company is still pushing technological boundaries – as a successful shaper of cutting-edge technologies such as artificial intelligence (AI), 6G, cloud and quantum technologies.

The privately owned company is known for stability and resilience. Independence is at the core of its entrepreneurial identity. The company finances its growth with its own resources. Because the company does not have to think in terms of quarterly results, it can plan sustainably for the long term. The high added value of Rohde & Schwarz makes the company a reliable, trustworthy and relevant partner for its customers.

Imprint: https://www.rohde-schwarz.com/general-information/imprint_101514.html

Name: Mobileum
Description:
Mobileum is a leading provider of Telecom analytics solutions for roaming, core network, security, risk management, domestic and international connectivity testing, and customer intelligence. More than 1,000 customers rely on its Active Intelligence platform, which provides advanced analytics solutions, allowing customers to connect deep network and operational intelligence with real-time actions that increase revenue, improve customer experience, and reduce costs. Headquartered in Silicon Valley, Mobileum has global offices in Australia, Germany, Greece, India, Japan, Portugal, Singapore, UK, and United Arab Emirates.

Name: EXFO
Description:
EXFO develops smarter test, measurement and monitoring solutions for the global communications industry. We are trusted advisors to fixed and mobile network operators, hyperscalers and leaders in the manufacturing, development and research sector. They count on us to deliver superior visibility and insights into network performance, service reliability and user experience. Building on nearly 40 years of innovation, EXFO’s unique blend of equipment, software and services enable faster, more confident transformations related to 5G, cloud-native and fiber optic networks.

To find out more, visit www.EXFO.com and follow us on our blog - https://www.exfo.com/en/resources/blog/

Name: SES Satellites
Description: At SES, we believe that space has the power to make a difference. That’s why we design space solutions that help governments protect, businesses grow, and people stay connected—no matter where they are. With integrated multi-orbit satellites and our global terrestrial network, we deliver resilient, seamless connectivity and the highest quality video content to those shaping what’s next. Following our Intelsat acquisition, we now offer more than 100 years of combined global industry leadership—backed by a track record of bringing innovation “firsts” to market. As a trusted partner to customers and the global space ecosystem, SES is driving impact that goes far beyond coverage.

Name: Infinera
Description:
Infinera is now part of Nokia.

Infinera is revolutionizing telecommunications networks with innovative, industry-leading connectivity solutions. Our offerings include high-end subcomponent technology, systems for network infrastructure, automation software, advanced optical compound semiconductor manufacturing, & professional services. As a global supplier, we empower mobile service providers, internet content providers, cloud operators, submarine operators, governments & enterprises to scale network bandwidth, boost service innovation, and automate network operations. We are committed to continuously expanding and enhancing our world-class offerings to meet the changing needs of our customers. 

Our connectivity solutions are powered by the world’s best embedded & pluggable optical engines, which are designed, developed & manufactured in Infinera’s U.S.-based optical semiconductor fabrication center and are application-optimized for edge, metro, long-haul, and submarine transport networks. Our agile, open, compact & modular networking platforms enable network operators to rapidly and easily take advantage of best-in-class technology. Our software automation solutions optimize traffic flows and automate workloads to enable network operators to cost-effectively deliver secure bandwidth to their customers where and when needed. With these solutions, our goal is to create a connected world with unlimited bandwidth for everyone – everywhere, always, and instantly.


What Inspires Us? 
A connected world with unlimited bandwidth for everyone – everywhere, always & instantly. 

What Motivates Us?
Delivering innovative and impactful coherent optical technologies and open optical solutions that unlock new value for our customers. 

What Drives Us?
To be a valued investment for our shareholders’ money, our customers’ CapEx and our employees’ time by delivering an unrivaled customer experience from an inclusive culture of innovation for our customers.

Name: Nokia Bell Labs
Description: Throughout our 100-year history, Nokia Bell Labs has overcome some of the world’s biggest scientific challenges by bringing together the brightest minds in mathematics, physics, computing and engineering. We identify a problem, and then commit our best people to find a solution. As Nokia’s industrial research lab, we innovate with purpose, pursuing responsible, sustainable technologies that will have a demonstrable impact on society. Name: Monty Mobile

As a trusted technology enabler, we deliver integrated solutions across messaging, communication, connectivity, anti-fraud protection, monetization, operator management, data centralization, analytics, and fintech. Name: 1GLOBAL
Description:
WE’RE ON A MISSION TO CONNECT THE WORLD SEAMLESSLY

That’s why we aim to enable more connections than anyone else and why we’ve been pioneering the eSIM revolution from the very beginning.

From international enterprises and consumers to IOT device makers and Telecommunications operators, our global network and connectivity solutions enable people, devices and networks to connect anywhere, instantly, with one platform to connect billions.

Headquartered in the Netherlands and with offices across five continents, we’ve invested over £550 million in building our unique proposition and becoming one of the world’s leading innovators in eSIM, cloud and digital solutions.

As a result, we’ve become a leading technology company and eSIM trailblazer that’s trusted by thousands of international businesses across hundreds of countries, including global brands, powerhouse network providers  and leading banks and financial institutions.

One truly global network.

One global supplier.

One complete solution that revolutionises the world of connectivity and connects people, devices and networks seamlessly all around the world.

Because we believe that the better the world communicates, the better the world.

Name: Synchronoss Technologies
Description: Synchronoss Technologies (Nasdaq: SNCR), a global leader in personal Cloud solutions, empowers service providers to establish secure and meaningful connections with their subscribers. Millions of subscribers trust Synchronoss to safeguard their most cherished memories and important digital content. Explore how our Cloud-focused solutions redefine the way you connect with your digital world at www.synchronoss.com.

Name: Boldyn Networks
Description:
At Boldyn Networks we unlock the power of an interconnected future. Building shared communications infrastructure that enables new possibilities for connected transit, venues, enterprise, next-generation networks, and smart cities.

Made up of innovative, bold, and dynamic thinkers, we are one of the largest neutral host providers in the world. Our extensive experience in deploying shared communications infrastructure spans the US, UK, France, Ireland, Spain, Finland, Italy and Germany. And with our comprehensive solution set and portfolio, we empower you to turn your strategic connectivity vision into reality.

Backed by CPP Investments and its C$632 billion net assets, we possess the financial capacity and capability to undertake large and complex infrastructure projects. Consistently delivering innovative solutions that have a real impact. From mobile coverage in the London Underground to private networks on offshore wind farms, self-driving buses, and groundbreaking 5G experiences in major venues worldwide, we are driving transformative advancements. Boldyn Networks. Reimagine Tomorrow. Transform Today.

Name: Spirent Communications

We provide innovative products, services, and managed solutions that address the test, assurance, and automation challenges of a new generation of technologies, including 5G, 6G, cloud, autonomous vehicles, and beyond. Name: Flint International
Description:
Services designed for you to reduce cost, accelerate new technology introduction and provide international scaling.

Flint is an international services company with over 20 years’ experience helping customers solve their technical challenges. We are deeply rooted within the ICT community, with Flint starting its journey as an engineering company in 1999. In-depth knowledge of the industry and technology gives our company a unique understanding of our customers’ challenges and objectives. We are committed to building strong and long-lasting relationships with our customers, some already spanning close to 20 years. 

Our comprehensive portfolio of lifecycle services enables customers to design, implement and operate their networks in a cost-effective and agile manner.

With expertise in mobile, automation, orchestration, enterprise networking, security and data centre; our technical experts can help you reduce time to market and provide additional capacity or capability to your in-house team.

Flint’s team of 3500 currently supports over 50 customers in more than 40 countries throughout Europe, the Middle East, Africa, Asia, Oceania, and North America.

Name: Gamma
Description:
Gamma Communications is a leading provider of technology-based communication solutions across Europe. With over 2,200 employees and listed on the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange, Gamma helps organisations connect and collaborate through solutions including Unified Communications, voice enablement, connectivity, mobile and security.
Gamma’s vision is a better-connected world – working smarter for the benefit of businesses, people and the planet. Selling exclusively to businesses and public sector organisations, Gamma’s core markets are the UK and Germany, with additional presence in Spain and the Benelux region.
In the UK, Gamma serves SMEs through an extensive network of over 1,500 channel partners (Gamma Business). For larger businesses and public sector organisations, Gamma Enterprise engages directly to design, deliver, and support complex, integrated communications solutions. Gamma Europe has its largest presence in Germany, where it operates through a combination of a strong partner network and a self-service digital platform and is now one of the country’s leading cloud communications providers, following strategic acquisitions.
For more information about Gamma and its full range of products and services, visit gammagroup.co

Name: China Telecom Europe
Description:
Looking to grow your business in China-APAC or establish a presence? China Telecom Europe (CTE) can help you. CTE is a wholly-owned subsidiary of China Telecom Global (CTG), the international arm of China Telecom.

Name: Telefónica Germany
Description:
Telefónica’s mission is to give everyone access to the best digital products and technologies available. 

Telefónica Deutschland ensures that digitalization works in everyday life, contributes to economic strength, and helps Germany remain competitive in an increasingly digital world. This includes a high-performance 5G mobile network, fixed-line services, digital innovations, the Internet of Things, and a strong focus on sustainability.

Name: Connect44
Description:
The Only Telecoms Service Provider You Need 

As one of Europe’s largest independent, vendor-agnostic, fixed & mobile services and solutions providers, we offer a comprehensive network planning, build and management solutions portfolio. 

The Connect44 Group of companies was founded in 2000 in Luzern, Switzerland, by James Rogerson and Leo Kidel.

As the industry evolves, we offer a complete end-to-end solutions portfolio, including network planning, building, and management for network operators, fibre companies, and telecoms Site Providers.

Name: AudioCodes
Description:
AudioCodes Ltd. (NASDAQ, TASE: AUDC) is a global leader in enterprise voice technology and voice AI innovation.

We help organizations unlock the full value of voice, transforming every conversation into a strategic asset that drives smarter decisions, better experiences and business growth.

Our portfolio spans secure voice infrastructure, unified communications and contact center integration and next-generation AI-powered voice solutions. 

With over 30 years of expertise and a presence in more than 100 countries, AudioCodes is trusted by 65 of the Fortune 100 to power intelligent, agile and future-ready interactions across the enterprise.

Name: Sigfox 0G technology
Description:
Sigfox 0G (Zero-G) technology is a Low-Power Wide-Area (LPWAN) IoT networking protocol dedicated to Massive IoT. It is designed to connect devices at a low-cost, ultra energy-efficient and secure manner.

Sigfox 0G technology is owned by UnaBiz, a proven global Massive IoT service provider, and has been adopted by 70+ national 0G Operators as a global standard. Together, UnaBiz and the 0G Operators provide the Global 0G Network that connects over 10 million sensors for 1500 B2B customers worldwide to power sustainable business growth.

Name: Italtel
Description:
We help our customers to choose the most suitable solutions for the characteristics of their business, to develop the traditional communication technologies they already have in the field, in order to integrate them with new technologies according to hybrid-cloud and cybersecurity logic. 

We do that thanks to our robust ability for system integration with multi-technology application, on products and technologies developed by us or by third parties. We support customers, Telco Service Providers or large public and private companies, over time with our managed services. Creating value for customers is our leading star, and our 1,500 professionals are strongly committed to this.

Our core business focuses on the design, development and deployment of communications networks and on the provision of collaborative solutions created by integrating state-of-the-art technologies.

LINK Mobility Group AS is a CPaaS provider headquarted in Oslo, Norway. We are one of Europe's leading providers within mobile communications, specializing in mobile messaging services and mobile solutions.

We continue to experience strong organic growth with a high degree of recurring revenue as customers tend to move more business activities onto the mobile platforms.

Name: Snom Technology GmbH
Description:
About Snom Technology GmbH
 
Founded in 1997 and headquartered in Berlin Germany, Snom is a German multinational corporation and the world’s first and leading brand of professional and enterprise VoIP telephones. 
 
Snom's German engineering is globally renowned for robust, high-quality and feature-rich business telephones that are designed exclusively for the trained and certified professional IT and PBX installer. All of Snom’s products are universally compatible with leading PBX platforms operating under the SIP standard with over 4 million end-point installations globally. Snom products are sold through distributors to over 25,000 Snom Value Added Resellers across the world. 

For more information, please visit www.snom.com.

- Automotive Industry

- Medial & Industry

Digital wireless communication forms the central nervous system of everything we do. Around this resilient, robust core we design, develop, manufacture, test, deploy, support and manage innovative communication environments for organizations that have to put their total trust in the systems and people they work with.   

We’ve worked hard to develop genuine insight into our clients’ worlds, and have pursued engineering, operational and services excellence for more than 50 years. This understanding, and our belief in championing open-standards technology, means we can give our clients the best possible choice and value to achieve the human outcomes they’re driven by.   

We’re not simply aligned with our clients; we’re devoted to their cause.   

Tait Communications’ sole dividend receiving shareholder is a charitable trust which shares the company’s operating profits across several donation and investment streams responsible for research and development, regional reinvestment and education.

Name: Vantage Towers
Description:
Vantage Towers is one of Europe’s leading tower companies. Our infrastructure and technologies are creating better connections in an ever-changing, increasingly digital world.

With around 88,000 towers across 10 markets, we’re accelerating the digitisation of our communities by connecting people, businesses, and Internet-enabled devices like never before. We combine the scale, stability and quality of Europe’s leading tower network with the agility, optimism and energy of a start-up. We’re inspired by our past successes and excited by the opportunities in front of us.

In an emerging future, where mobile phones are only one component of a digital world inhabited by wearable technology and IoT, we provide the fabric for connecting hundreds of thousands of devices in just a single kilometre. We want operators, industry and agriculture to benefit from faster, greener, more reliable, more secure and more efficient connectivity. We want our markets, customers and consumers to take up a leading position at the forefront of a 5G world and meet both rural and urban demand. No matter the network coverage or capacity challenges, our infrastructure and people will come together to ensure our solutions stand the test of time, all the time. 

Together, we accelerate a sustainably connected Europe.

Description:

Name: Airbus Public Safety and Security
Description:
At Public Safety and Security, part of Airbus Defence and Space, we deliver the future of critical collaboration to connect the many people working to protect us every day.

Our customers and end users are governments and private organisations in sectors including public safety, defence, transportation, utilities, healthcare, and event security. We support their digital transformation by offering the latest in integrated, secure and cyber-resilient mission- and business-critical communication and collaboration solutions with professional services.

Our advanced solutions, combining narrowband (TETRA, Tetrapol) and broadband (Agnet) technologies, enhance situational awareness, improve user experience and safety, and optimise operational efficiency. Our dense portfolio is field-proven and tailored to our customers’ needs, with a range of infrastructures, networks, devices, accessories, applications, software and services using cutting-edge technologies. 

Actively involved in multinational R&D projects and 3GPP standardisation, we set the standards for future technologies running on 4G and 5G. 

The European leader of critical communications with 40 years of experience, we have global reach with customers in 80 countries and over 1,200 employees in 20 countries.

For more information, visit our website: https://www.criticalcommunications.airbus.com/en.

Name: Wireless Logic
Description:
A new thing, device or asset is connected to our cellular platform every 18 seconds of every day. And today, we have over 20 million IoT subscriptions active in 165 countries, with collaborative partnerships that provide reach into more than 750 mobile networks across the globe. 

Our purpose-built IoT connectivity platforms connect (globally and locally) across multiple mobile networks and technologies to give customers a single management window for their assets. It provides the ultimate connectivity, control and security for IoT and M2M applications.

We are entirely customer and market-driven, meeting our 10,000+ customers where they are to help them innovate by providing expert service and the most flexible, resilient and secure connectivity solutions in the market. 

From EPOS systems in retail stores, to behaviour monitoring in vehicles and off-grid solar power in remote rural regions of East Africa. We have expertise across multiple sectors and use cases, including agriculture, healthcare, security, transport, utilities and building management.  We work with a diverse client base that includes global OEMs, system integrators, solution providers, application developers, blue-chip enterprises and start-ups.

We are headquartered in the UK with local offices in US, Germany, Netherlands, France, Spain, Italy Denmark, Norway, Austria, Brazil, Singapore, Malaysia and China. 

We are backed by Montagu Private Equity, one of the world’s leading private equity-backed investors, giving Wireless Logic Group unrivalled financial strength.

For careers information go to https://wirelesslogic.com/careers

Name: Aginode
Description:
We Are Aginode. Let’s Enable More.

For over a century Aginode (headquartered in Paris, France) has been designing, manufacturing, and delivering flexible connectivity solutions that connect the world’s digital networks. From broadband infrastructure to mission-critical data ecosystems, we enable smarter, faster, and more resilient connections. 

Trusted by  more than 10 000 customers across industries, including data centers, finance, office & enterprise, and airports, our solutions are delivered under flagship brands: For LAN & Data Centres:  LANmarkTM, LANsenseTM, LANactive, and for 5G & FTTx:  XPLORERTM & UPSKYTM. 

Operating from a flexible, in-region industrial footprint and recognized technological capabilities across APAC and EMEA, Aginode teams up with global sales and distribution networks to accelerate digital transformation. 

At the core of everything we do are our values: One Team. Care. Drive. 
One Team. Our 500+ experts collaborate across borders and backgrounds, combining global reach with local insight. From engineers to field teams to partners, we act as one: aligned, agile, and unstoppable.
Care. We care deeply — about our people, our partners and our planet. Reliability, trust, and sustainability are built into every product, every decision, every partnership.
Drive. We’re always moving forward. We improve and push the limits of what’s possible in digital infrastructure. Speed matters. So does impact.

Let’s enable more in the world’s broadband ecosystem.

Name: Mynaric
Description: Mynaric develops and produces laser communications terminals for air, space and mobile applications. Laser communication networks enable ultra-high data rates and secure, long-distance data transmission between moving platforms across airborne and space-based networks. The company is headquartered in Munich, Germany, with an additional location in Los Angeles, California. In April 2026, Mynaric was acquired by Rocket Lab Corporation (Nasdaq: RKLB). For more information, visit www.mynaric.com.

Name: euNetworks
Description:
euNetworks (@euNetworks) is a European provider of bandwidth infrastructure services. We focus on delivering scalable, fibre based products and solutions to a customer base that is at the centre of technology transformation. Our customers require fibre based data centre to data centre connectivity, both within the key cities in Europe and between these cities, supporting both their bandwidth growth and the performance requirements that their applications demand. Our customers' needs shape how we develop our network further. 

We own and operate 18 fibre based metropolitan networks across Europe connected with a high capacity intercity backbone covering 53 cities in 18 countries. Our metro networks are in London, Manchester, Dublin, Amsterdam, Rotterdam, Utrecht, Paris, Frankfurt, Cologne, Dusseldorf, Stuttgart, Munich, Hamburg, Berlin, Vienna, Milan, Madrid & Brussels.

euNetworks leads the market in data centre connectivity, directly connecting over 600+ in Europe today. We are also a leading cloud connectivity provider, with direct connection to all key cloud platforms, and access to additional platforms. Our product set of Fibre, Wavelengths and Ethernet is bundled to deliver bandwidth solutions for our customers, from euTrade to cloud connect, dc connect, media connect and private connect MOFN. 

Wholesale, finance, content, media, data centre and enterprise customers benefit from euNetworks' unique inventory of fibre and duct based assets that are tailored to fulfill their high bandwidth needs. 

euNetworks is headquartered in London with offices across Europe to support customers locally. For further information please visit eunetworks.com and http://map.eunetworks.com/ to see the network and connected buildings.

Subscribe to receive updates from euNetworks- https://www.eunetworks.com/subscribe/

Name: European Computer Telecoms
Description:
ECT is a tech company dedicated to better business outcomes for communications service providers (CSPs) and their customers. With our Telecoms Low Code (TLC), Packaged Business Capabilities (PBCs), ready-to-use apps and agile co-development, we enable CSPs to compose, enhance and individualize telecoms services and products implemented within their telecoms network. We believe that business customers are ready to pay a premium price for reliable, individualized services, continuously evolving in cooperation with their trusted CSP. Toward this end, we collaborate with CSPs long-term and continuously, responding agilely to new and changing use cases, requests from individual customers, and emerging opportunities. 

Research and development are also a top ECT priority: we consult closely with leading analysts, implement emerging technologies and products early, and then test their viability together with the CSPs in our ecosystem. In addition to our own direct sales and service, primarily in Europe, we also partner with Nokia Networks which offers our products and services worldwide. 
Together with our clients, we at ECT enjoy meeting challenges and creating opportunities.

Founded in 1998, ECT is an unlisted German public company with its headquarters in Munich, Germany and wholly-owned sales and service subsidiaries in England, The Netherlands and the USA.

Name: O-RAN ALLIANCE
Description:
O-RAN ALLIANCE is a world-wide community of mobile operators, vendors, and research & academic institutions operating in the Radio Access Network (RAN) industry. 

As the RAN is an essential part of any mobile network, O-RAN ALLIANCE's mission is to re-shape the industry towards more intelligent, open, virtualized and fully interoperable mobile networks. 

The new O-RAN standards enable a more competitive and vibrant RAN supplier ecosystem with faster innovation to improve user experience. O-RAN-compliant mobile networks will at the same time improve the efficiency of RAN deployments as well as operations by the mobile operators. 

To achieve this, O-RAN ALLIANCE publishes new RAN specifications, releases open software for the RAN, and supports its members in integration and testing of their implementations.

For more information please visit www.o-ran.org .

Name: PROSE Technologies

In PROSE, our mission is to connect people's lives, their work, and everything in between. We strive to provide the most innovative and advanced wireless communications solutions in the market and are proud of being an industry leader.

Name: emnify

emnify is the leading IoT connectivity partner to the innovators building our connected world. Our solution connects millions of devices across all industries including fleet management, consumer electronics, logistics, agriculture, environmental monitoring, smart buildings, retail, and beyond. Name: T Business Europe
Description:
Telekom Business Europe is your helping hand and go-to partner for a successful digital transformation. We develop innovative solutions and services as well as expert support for a smart, secure, and sustainable future.

Digital by nature, we empower small and medium-sized businesses, enterprises, and public sectors across Central and Eastern Europe (CEE) to unleash their potential and reach their biggest goals: communicating securely and seamlessly, benefitting from remote and hybrid work, migrating to the cloud, utilizing data, and going digital for improved sustainability. 

From employees to customers and citizens, people are at the heart of everything we do. That’s why we’re committed to helping solve challenges and boosting local businesses by focusing on needs, bringing together our global expertise as a trusted partner for top industry players, and realizing the potential of fixed, mobile, and connectivity solutions as well as technologies such as the Cloud, the Internet of Things, Big Data, and much more.

We do it all—from ultra-fast 5G connections and productive office collaboration software all the way to secure data storage, proven industrial solutions, and end-to-end cybersecurity. Our unique offering bundles the powerful infrastructure of a world-leading telecommunications company, Deutsche Telekom, with one of the largest mobile and fiber-optic networks in the CEE region, highly secure data centers in Europe compliant with EU data protection laws, certified partnerships, and 24/7 support.

Our mission is simple: to drive your digital transformation and shape the world of tomorrow. And no matter whether we’re partnering with small stores facing a big future, international companies with economic and sustainability goals, or public institutions and cities striving to ensure a livable environment, our shared goal is clear: Creating a prosperous future for all.

Name: Artemis ITS

Artemis ITS Group, established in February 2008, provides integrated services in telecommunication and energy networks.

The company is defined by intensive effort, careful selection of staff and partners, with particular emphasis on university education and prior work experience of all of our staff in specific areas of activities of our company. The above strategy resulted in a short time to participate actively and dynamically in the development / upgrade of telecommunication digital networks in several European Countries, the design and installation of energy systems that mainly use renewable energy sources as well as in the development and commercialization of software platforms for smart management applications.

Name: Deutsche GigaNetz GmbH
Description: Die Deutsche GigaNetz GmbH mit Hauptsitz in Hamburg betreibt in Deutschland einen qualitätsorientierten Glasfasernetzausbau bis in die eigenen vier Wände (FttH – Fiber To The Home). Damit leistet das Unternehmen einen erheblichen Beitrag zur Digitalisierung Deutschlands mit der Teilhabe aller Bürgerinnen und Bürger an der dafür notwendigen Infrastruktur. Mit einem klaren Fokus auf den eigenwirtschaftlichen Ausbau ist es Ziel des Unternehmens, flächendeckend Glasfaser in den Kommunen zu bauen und dabei vorhandene Infrastrukturen als auch die Förderkulisse ergänzend einzubeziehen. Die Deutsche GigaNetz schafft ein nachhaltiges Qualitätsnetz für die nächsten Generationen durch qualitativ hochwertige Verlegeverfahren, das auch als Open-Access-Lösung diskriminierungsfrei offen für andere Anbieter ist. Mit weniger Energieverbrauch im Netzbetrieb gegenüber bisherigen Kupfernetzen leistet die Deutsche GigaNetz auch einen Beitrag zur ökologischen Nachhaltigkeit in den Kommunen.

Name: Emtelle

With 40 years of experience, Emtelle's competitive strength lies in strong technological capabilities, in relentless research and development, and in people whose dedication and professionalism are exemplary. Description:
The new era of telecommunication in Pakistan has brought several challenges with it, despite of the advantages it has made visible for the consumers. The most important being the challenge to keep intact the security requirements of the Government of Pakistan and to protect the new players in this field from the conventional practices of the incumbent operators to protect their market share. To overcome these challenges GoP established National Telecommunication Corporation (NTC) in January 1996 under the Telecom Reorganization Act 1996

Future Thoughts
------------------------
Being aware of the new technologies, demand for new services and converged network NTC is in the process of upgrading and expanding its network. Migration from conventional TDM network to IP based Next Generation Network has been planned and being implemented. The 622 Mbps optical fiber backbone not able to meet the requirement of bandwidth hungry applications is being upgraded to 10 Gbps DWDM based technology. To improve the efficiency ERP solution has been planned and under process of implementation. To gain access to NTC users efforts are being made for frequency allocation and as a stop gap arrangement virtual WLL connections are being provided to NTC subscribers. Aber nicht nur das: auch der Großteil unserer Mitarbeitenden sind mittlerweile waschechte Ostwestfalen. Denn wer erstmal bei uns angefangen hat zu arbeiten, möchte nicht mehr gehen und darauf sind wir verdammt stolz .

und noch viel mehr.

How do we help businesses?
Since 2006, we have helped more than 4,000 companies modernise the way they communicate. Our focus is on business telephony, reachability across locations, mobile teams and system integration, bringing calls, customer information and follow up workflows together in the places where teams actually work.

What do we share on LinkedIn?
On LinkedIn, we share insights from our projects, current developments in VoIP, business communications and digital infrastructure, along with practical examples for companies that want to improve how they can be reached, modernise their communication workflows and connect telephony with their existing processes.

Why does an open technology approach matter?
An open technology approach means telephony adapts to the way a business actually works, not the other way around. ansitel can be run as a cloud phone system, an on premises phone system or a software based phone system, and can be integrated with core business systems such as CRM, ERP, service workflows, industry specific software and AI supported applications.

This allows companies to keep using existing systems, build modern VoIP structures and make telephony available exactly where service, sales and administration teams work every day.

What do we do differently?

Description:
Deutsche Funkturm is a key player in developing infrastructure for German mobile network operators, broadcasters, operators of radio relays, and the radio networks of authorities and other institutions.

The company was founded in 2002 as a subsidiary of Deutsche Telekom and has had the U.S. company DigitalBridge and Canada's Brookfield as additional shareholders since 2023. With a portfolio of around 34,600 antenna sites in Germany, Deutsche Funkturm is the largest operator of radio infrastructure in Germany. It is represented throughout Germany, and the company is headquartered in Münster.

As a full-service provider of active and passive infrastructure, Deutsche Funkturm acquires, plans, realizes, operates, and markets radio sites throughout Germany. Its portfolio includes towers, masts, rooftop sites, distributed antenna systems (DAS), and small cells. The company is a major contributor to the development of infrastructure for mobile communications providers in Germany. Its current focus is on LTE and 5G.

For the European Aviation Network (EAN), the world's first radio network for airplanes that combines satellite communication and LTE, Deutsche Funkturm acquired, planned, and built the entire ground-based network with about 300 transmitting stations in 30 European countries.

The best of two worlds – CTC advanced GmbH and CETECOM GmbH merge to form cetecom advanced GmbH

This merger creates a unified company from two leading suppliers in the field of testing and certification of electronic products with or without wireless interfaces, which meets the requirements of its customers even more comprehensively.
Both companies have been among the absolute know-how carriers in their industry for 25 years. The service portfolio of the two entities, which together belong to the RWTÜV Group, coincides in many accredited areas and additionally complements each other with further services.

The merger creates a company with a comprehensive range of diverse high-quality laboratory and certification services under one roof.

Name: Genexis
Description:
Genexis brings the world to everyone’s home. We enable people to participate in the digital society and access essential services and applications. Fast and user-friendly digital connectivity improves people's quality of life and positively impacts their world. By creating innovative, more sustainable, and intuitive products, we make it easy for homes to connect to the world. 

Genexis is a leading European vendor of innovative broadband solutions for the home. Our customers are network operators, internet service providers, and fiber network installers. Genexis’ portfolio consists of ONTs, residential gateways, extenders, open-source-based operating systems, and communication management software. We are a European company headquartered in Stockholm (SE) and Eindhoven (NL). Genexis has a Sustainability Linked Bond listed on Nasdaq Stockholm and has earned the EcoVadis Gold medal for sustainability.

Name: Westconnect
Description:
Leistungsstarkes Glasfaser-Internet ist das Rückgrat für digitales Leben und Arbeiten, für Industrie 4.0 und moderne Verwaltung. Die Westconnect GmbH mit Sitz in Essen ist ein Joint Venture der E.ON-Tochter Westenergie und Igneo Infrastructure Partners. Der Glasfaserausbau der Westconnect findet vor allem in Nordrhein-Westfalen, Rheinland-Pfalz, Niedersachsen und Hessen statt. Westconnect hat bereits mehr als zwei Millionen Einwohner*innen sowie Betrieben Zugang zu leistungsstarkem Internet verschafft. 

Die Internetprodukte der Westconnect finden sich unter der Marke E.ON Highspeed (eon-highspeed.com).

Name: GVG Glasfaser
Description:
Wir planen, bauen und betreiben Glasfasernetze direkt bis in die Gebäude unserer Endkunden. Anspruch der GVG Glasfaser mit ihren Tochterunternehmen 2locate und 2provide ist es, die Unternehmen und Privathaushalte gesamter Regionen an die Telekommunikationsinfrastruktur der Zukunft anzuschließen. Mit einer Vielzahl professioneller und erfahrener Partner bilden wir ein Netzwerk, das die gesamte Bandbreite des Glasfaserausbaus abbildet. Unser Fokus liegt auf der Verbesserung der Breitbandversorgung insbesondere ländlicher Regionen.

Mit unseren Marken nordischnet und teranet versorgen wir bundesweit Privat- und Geschäftskunden mit hochleistungsfähigen Internet-, Telefonie und Fernsehdiensten mit Bandbreiten von 50 MBit/s bis 1 GBit/s. Mittlerweile ist die GVG in über 260 Kommunen aktiv und bietet mehr als 180.000 Haushalten und Unternehmen einen ultraschnellen Glasfaseranschluss. Damit ist sie einer der führenden deutschen Telekommunikationsanbieter in puncto echte Glasfaseranschlüsse.

Als Partner von Zweckverbänden oder im eigenwirtschaftlichen Ausbau haben wir uns als Ziel gesetzt, deutschlandweit Endkunden eine direkte Glasfaseranbindung zu ermöglichen und hierdurch den Zugang zur Zukunft sicherzustellen.

Die Unternehmensgruppe GVG Glasfaser:

- Muttergesellschaft 2014 in Kiel gegründet
- Geschäftsführung: Thorsten Fellmann, Michael Hegemann, Susanne Küppers
- ca. 260 feste Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter

Name: Gamma Business
Description:
For more than 20 years, Gamma, together with the channel, has provided voice, connectivity and collaboration solutions that have helped transform business communications across all sectors and business sizes.  

We understand what you need to be successful in your markets and have the service portfolio and people to make this happen. With a variety of partner models to choose from, an award-winning partner programme, Gamma is a financially secure choice with an extensive portfolio underpinned by a highly resilient network.  

For more information about Gamma and its comprehensive range of services for partners, please visit  https://gammagroup.co/partner-solutions/

Gamma Communications plc

Gamma Communications is a leading provider of technology-based communication solutions across Europe. With over 2,200 employees and listed on the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange, Gamma helps organisations connect and collaborate through solutions including Unified Communications, voice enablement, connectivity, mobile and security.
Gamma’s vision is a better-connected world – working smarter for the benefit of businesses, people and the planet. Selling exclusively to businesses and public sector organisations, Gamma’s core markets are the UK and Germany, with additional presence in Spain and the Benelux region.
In the UK, Gamma serves SMEs through an extensive network of over 1,500 channel partners (Gamma Business). For larger businesses and public sector organisations, Gamma Enterprise engages directly to design, deliver, and support complex, integrated communications solutions. Gamma Europe has its largest presence in Germany, where it operates through a combination of a strong partner network and a self-service digital platform and is now one of the country’s leading cloud communications providers, following strategic acquisitions.
For more information about Gamma and its full range of products and services, visit gammagroup.co

Name: HUBER+SUHNER Cube Optics AG
Description:
HUBER+SUHNER Cube Optics; Pushing the boundaries of fiber optical transport for more than 20 years
Fiber optical transport is the backbone of the global data transmission. For more than 20 years we at HUBER+SUHNER Cube Optics are providing passive and active fiber optical transport solutions to network operators across the globe as well as micro-optical components to for example transceiver manufacturers. 
At HUBER+SUHNER Cube Optics we believe that it is crucial to work closely with the customers in order to truly understand the fundamental challenges and being able to provide the best possible solution.

Name: STRAX GmbH
Description: We are a leading specialist in accessories for mobile devices. Our portfolio includes house brands, partner brands as well as private-label brands for renowned customers. We distribute over 40 partner brands across all relevant channels. Headquartered in Troisdorf (near Cologne/Bonn), we have a state of-the-art warehouse with over 4500m2. Our additional distribution subsidiaries are strategically positioned in nine countries across Europe. At present, we have c. 100 FTEs.

Name: Actix
Description:
Actix enables mobile operators to optimize customer experience in the RAN and maximise the value of their network. Actix provides street-level visibility into subscriber experience and network quality driving effective optimization and SON solutions that deliver a better customer experience and reduce costs.  

Actix also helps BSS/OSS solution providers transform their understanding of the RAN and deliver solutions that drive new revenues.  Actix provides powerful insights into subscriber location, handset performance and network quality enabling them to enrich the solutions they offer mobile operators.

Actix’s network analytics and optimization capabilities are hosted on ActixOne the industry’s first, most powerful and widely deployed multi-vendor and multi-technology optimization platform.  ActixOne’s modular architecture allows operators to address over 40 common use cases on a single platform including: Geo-located Customer Experience Analytics,  Network Acceptance, Optimization & SON and Competitive Benchmarking to name but a few.

ActixOne has an open web-based interface which means radio access, geo-location data and analytics can be shared across an organization and be exposed to third party applications.  This enables mobile operators and BSS/OSS solution providers to extract the maximum value and insights from the RAN.

For more information visit www.actix.com

Name: CallCabinet
Description:
CallCabinet’s revolutionary compliance call recording solutions are enabling unrestricted business intelligence within any communications environment.

Name: Rolling Wireless
Description:
Rolling Wireless is the world’s leading supplier of cellular network access devices (NADs) to the automotive industry, with over 60 million automotive-grade cellular modules shipped to date.

Building on more than two decades of innovation and operational excellence, Rolling Wireless helps automotive OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers create applications that enhance safety, delight drivers, and generate additional revenue. The company’s unique software platform enables customers to build Linux-based telematics control units (TCUs) on a single module.

Rolling Wireless was established as an independent company in 2020. Headquartered in Luxembourg, the company employs more than 300 automotive experts worldwide.

Name: NGMN Alliance
Description: NGMN - Next Generation Mobile Networks Alliance - is a global, operator-driven organisation, established by leading international mobile network operators (MNOs). As a global alliance of nearly 70 companies and organisations - including operators, vendors and academia - NGMN provides industry guidance to enable innovative, sustainable and affordable next-generation mobile network infrastructure. Key focus areas include Mastering the Route to Disaggregation, Green Future Networks and 6G, while supporting the full implementation of 5G. NGMN drives global alignment of technology standards, fosters collaboration with industry organisations, and ensures efficient, project-driven processes to address the evolving demands of the telecommunications ecosystem.

Name: brodos
Description:
Mit Hauptsitz im mittelfränkischen Baiersdorf, rund 550 Mitarbeitern und einem Umsatz von über 750 Millionen Euro zählt Brodos – gegründet 1991 – zu den größten Mobilfunk Dienstleistern rund um das Smartphone und Tablet in Deutschland. Man kann sagen wir haben den Mobilfunk im Blut und das von Anfang an.

Mobilfunk ist ein komplexes Produkt und setzt sich aus der Kombination der Geräte von Herstellern und den Tarifen der Netzbetreiber zusammen. 
Brodos ist Lieferant und Businessprozess Operator für Kunden und Anbieter gleichermaßen. Mit einer Vielzahl von Dienstleistungen und Anwendungen rund um die Bereitstellung, Verfügbarkeit, Sicherheit mobiler Geräte und Anwendung erfüllen wir jede Anforderung im Mobilfunkmarkt.

Dabei hat Brodos im deutschen Mobilfunkmarkt seit über 30 Jahren als Dienstleister eine herausragende zentrale Position und ist strategischer Partner aller führenden Hersteller (Apple, Samsung, Motorola, Nokia, Xiaomi u.v.m.) sowie auch gleichzeitig aller deutscher Netzbetreiber (Telekom, Vodafone, Telefónica, 1&1). 
Mobilfunk wird gleichermaßen von Konsumenten und gerade in den letzten 5 Jahren sehr stark von Firmen für Ihre Mitarbeiter nachgefragt. 
Darum gehören zum Kundenstamm von Brodos vom regionalen Mobilfunkspezialisten über Systemhäuser und die großen Elektronikvermarkter vor allem auch die Geschäftskunden vom mittelständischen Unternehmen bis zum DAX-Konzern. 
Insgesamt arbeitet Brodos mit über 11.000 Kunden regelmäßig zusammen.

Name: EMC (Expanding Mobile Connectivity)
Description:
EMC specializes in mission-critical communications and content for organizations and people on the move in the most remote locations.  At sea, on land and in the air, the company provides seamless, reliable connectivity and access, leveraging its wholly-owned and operated satellite and terrestrial broadband network with fully meshed Multiprotocol Label Switching (MPLS) interconnected teleports.  EMC delivers live TV, on-demand video, Internet, voice, cellular and 3G services worldwide.  

The company operates in 140 countries and runs 52 worldwide field support centers.  The established EMC team, in business for 35 years, with unprecedented infrastructure and 20+ patented technologies, delivers industry firsts time and again.  EMC hires and trains its own field engineers to flexibly deploy support quickly around the world.  The company tailors its services for the most demanding users of mission-critical applications for the following sectors -- energy, cruise & ferries, yachts, commercial shipping, mobile network operators, government, The United Nations (UN) & non-governmental organizations (NGOs), and global enterprises.

The freenet Group is the largest network-independent telecommunications provider in Germany.

The Group offers its customers a comprehensive portfolio of services and products, primarily in the field of mobile voice and data services.

As a company, freenet AG has a responsibility not only to its customers and shareholders, but also – in the spirit of comprehensive stakeholder value – to its employees, the society, and the environment.

Name: i.safe MOBILE

Name: ZeroPhase

Name: mioty alliance
Description:
The mioty alliance is an open, non-profit community dedicated to advancing a robust and efficient Massive IoT connectivity solution. Founded by industry leaders, the alliance promotes mioty technology, a standardized wireless connectivity protocol based on Fraunhofer's patented Telegram Splitting Ultra-Narrow Band (TS-UNB) method.

Mioty is an ETSI (European Telecommunications Standards Institute) standard, specifically ETSI TS 103 357. This standardization ensures interoperability and compliance across the IoT ecosystem. The technology enables scalable and cost-effective Low Power Wide Area Network (LPWAN) deployments, making it ideal for industrial and commercial IoT applications.

The primary goal of the alliance is to develop and promote standards that ensure interoperability across the entire IoT value chain. By fostering collaboration among businesses, developers, hardware manufacturers, and system integrators, the mioty alliance aims to create a comprehensive ecosystem that drives the global success of the mioty protocol. Through these initiatives, the alliance is committed to shaping the future of Massive IoT connectivity and enabling transformative applications across various sectors.

Name: COMSENTRY
Description: Startup in the incubation phase supported by SSC Kaiserslautern and the Federal Ministry of Research, Technology and Space Germany. COMSENTRY is addressing a core bottleneck in next-generation wireless and sensing development. Today, teams building 6G / ISAC (integrated sensing and communication), radar, and high-speed links often have to stitch together SDR compute, RF frontends, and firmware themselves, resulting in slow iteration cycles, high integration effort, and limited reusability across projects. Our approach targets that by providing a compact, modular SDR hardware platform with exchangeable RF frontends as a flexible development base for future mobile and radar technologies. A second, very specific pain point they tackle is scaling to many coherent channels (e.g., massive-MIMO, distributed arrays, cooperative sensing): achieving phase-coherent clock/trigger distribution and synchronization across multiple modules is technically difficult and is frequently the limiting factor in real systems and testbeds—something their team highlights as a key expertise area and research focus.

With our products, we focus on the development of hardware systems to process broadband communication signals in real-time. Our benefits:

A FLEXIBLE, FUTURE-PROOF PLATFORM
The bitrecords technology is based on a flexible, future-proof platform that masters any transmitted data in real-time, regardless of the bandwidths used. Big data is no longer a challenge!

THE RIGHT MEANS ARE ALWAYS AT YOUR FINGERTIPS
The processing capabilities of the bitrecords platform can be transformed anytime on the fly, by software. This enables your operators to adapt their systems with any necessary tool kit. The right means are always at your fingertips.

24/7 REAL-TIME CONTENT PRODUCTION
Once the platform has been configured according to the missions's challenges and goals, it runs completely automatically - producing 24/7 real-time content.

INSIGHTS IN-TIME
Your experienced operators can concentrate on what they can do best: providing you with real-time insights delivering today's information - not yesterday's news!

Wir arbeiten mit allen Anbietern aus dem Gartner Report zusammen. Dies sind zur Zeit (Dezember 2018) Velocloud VMware, Cisco Viptela und Silver Peak im "Leaders" Bereich. Aber auch: Citrix Netscaler, Riverbed, Aryka, Huawei (Challengers), Versa, CloudGenix, Cato Netwoks (Visionaries). Die interessanten "Niche Player" von Gartner wie Juniper oder Nuage können auch je nach Kundenanforderung genutzt werden, aber auch Anbieter wie ZYXEL Nebula oder Open Source Lösungen, die gar nicht im Report berücksichtigt werden.

Neben dem eigentlichen SD WAN Anbieter benötigt der Kunde aber noch einen passenden Provider, der die Lösungen implementiert und betreibt, da die meisten Hersteller kein direktes Endkundengeschäft betreiben. 

 

Bei der weltweiten Beschaffung von Leitungen helfen wir Ihnen in fast 200 Ländern. Insbesondere für VDSL, Cable, LTE und Internet Standleitungen (DIA) in folgenden Staaten:

Argentinien, Australien, Brasilien, Frankreich, Indien, Indonesien, Italien, Japan, Kanada, Mexiko, Russland, Saudi Arabien, Südafrika, Südkorea, Türkei, UK, USA und China. In Deutschland und allen anderen EU Ländern natürlich auch. 

 

Wieso ist die direkte Beschaffung so wichtig? 

Der Grund liegt in der Einsparung der Kosten für den Zwischenhandel, da wir den idealen Providermix für jeden Standort weltweit festlegen können. So steigt die Redundanz und die Verfügbarkeit für jeden Standort, die Kosten aber sinken.

Name: Eigenbetrieb Digitale Infrastruktur Landkreis Cham
Description:
Der Landkreis Cham baut ein im Betreibermodell. Eines der größten Netze in ländlichen Räumen in Deutschland und das größte in Bayern. Das Netz ist 2300km! lang und versorgt ca. 19.000 Gebäude. Die Qualität des Netzausbaus sowie genügend Reserven für eine spätere Erweiterung stehen im Focus. Vodafone ist der Netzbetreiber für das gebaute Giganetz.
Einige weitere Keyfacts zum Ausbauprojekt: 4.000km Glasfaserkabel, 21.000km Leerrohre, 2.000 Kabelschächte, 19 POP Gebäude, nahezu komplette digitale Projektabwicklung, alle Daten im ESRI GIS-System ARCGIS Pro).

Der Eigenbetrieb des Landkreises hat in 5 Jahren eine Trasse mit einer Länge von 2.300 km gebaut, dies entspricht einer Distanz von Cham bis nach Tunis sowie 20.000 Gebäude/Grundstücke angeschlossen. Der größte Teil der gebauten Trasse, wurde am offenen Kabelgraben eingemessen und in über 300.000 Fotos dokumentiert.

Update November 2025: wir sind in Palermo  angekommen und sogar noch etwas weiter und zwar bis ans Ende von Sizilien. Beeindruckende Zahlen: Tiefbau mit 2.250km Trassenlänge in nur 5 Jahren mit mehr als 21.000km Leerrohren und 17.500 tats. Gebäudeanschlüssen, nix Homes passed . Im Mai 2026 werden alle weiẞen Flecken  im Landkreis mit einer Glasfaserleitung surfen  können (einschließlich jeder Milchkanne, jeder Berghütte, jeder Bauernhof, ....)

Update April 2024: wir haben die sog. Weißen Flecken (<30 MBit/s) nun vollständig erschlossen. Diese gehören im Landkreis Cham damit der Geschichte an. Ebenfalls erreichen wir eine Homes Activated Quote von über 50%.

Im März 2026 haben wir das 2. große Ausbauprojekt gestartet, mit weiteren 600km Trassenlänge und nochmals ca. 11.000 Gebäudeanschlüsse. Wir gehen wiederum von einer Homes Connected Quote von 90% aus.

Das Ziel eine vollständige Erschließung unserer 50.000 Gebäude im Landkreis Cham, mit einer Homes Connected Quote von deutlich über 80%, sollten wir 2029 erreichen. Damit kann die Kupfer-Glas-Migration starten.

Description:
Edenharter – Digitale Infrastruktur (E-DI) ist die unabhängige Beratung für gebäudeinterne Telekommunikationsinfrastruktur in der Wohnungswirtschaft.

Wir arbeiten ausschließlich auf Eigentümerseite. Keine Provisionen von Netzbetreibern, keine exklusiven Partnerschaften mit Herstellern, keine Bauleistung. Das ist unser Geschäftsmodell – und der Grund, warum unsere Empfehlungen belastbar sind.

Leistungen

• Infrastrukturpass – Bewertung des Gebäudebestands nach klar definierten Kriterien. 
Ergebnis: belastbare Entscheidungsgrundlage in einem Dokument.

• Entwicklungsstrategie – Roadmap für den Bestand. Welche Gebäude wann, mit welcher Technologie, zu welchen Kosten.

• Baubegleitung – Unabhängige Begleitung von Ausbauprojekten. Wir prüfen Ausführung gegen Norm und Vertrag.

• Bestandsdokumentation – Vollständige technische Dokumentation der vorhandenen Infrastruktur. Grundlage für jede weitere Entscheidung.

• Infrastrukturmanagement – Laufende Betreuung Ihrer NE4-Infrastruktur. Ansprechpartner, Koordination, Dokumentation.

Für wen wir arbeiten

Wohnungsbaugesellschaften, Bauträger, Projektentwickler und private Großeigentümer ab drei Gebäuden oder 30 Wohneinheiten. Regional in Oberpfalz und Niederbayern.

Warum jetzt

Mit der TKG-Novelle 2026 haben Netzbetreiber unter bestimmten Bedingungen das Recht, Glasfaser ohne Eigentümerzustimmung in Gebäuden zu verlegen. Eigentümer haben zwei Monate Zeit, eine eigene Strategie vorzulegen. Wer vorbereitet ist, behält Kontrolle über die eigene Infrastruktur – technisch und wirtschaftlich.

Description:

In 2009 - in the middle of the financial crisis - the company got into real troubles and couldn't withstand the drastic market changes.
